_comment: TDD M4 reverse named-effort slice, loss partition (strict): effort outside the known enum values is a diagnosed loss; strict rejects pre-IO with 400 translation_loss and zero upstream requests. Future-expected (source: reasoning.py values-membership drop). RED on baseline: hard refusal 400 invalid_generation_parameter (different code).
name: m4_reasoning_responses_chat_enum_mismatch_strict
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "bridge-resp"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o-mini"

[capabilities.overrides."bridge-resp".reasoning.effort]
supported = true
values = ["low", "medium"]
